lectureDateSource.dateOrderEvidence: cards dated 9/17/2026 and 9/18/2026 cannot be day-first; the rec-date tail after M/D/YYYY is a bullet separator plus time of day and is ignored
lectureDateSource.matchRule: exactly one card whose play-link href equals the canonicalized current player URL supplies the date; zero matches, multiple matches, or a failed same-origin fetch fail closed as rejected_ambiguous_metadata
lectureDateSource.dateMeaning: the rec-date is the lecture's recording date, evidenced by the observed card titled 'Lecture recorded on 9/17/2026' carrying rec-date 9/17/2026

completionIndicator.note: compound completion per the 2026-09-20 plan revision: the observed shape has no explicit in-container complete marker, so completion requires the open-state title, at least one row with nonempty text, and two identical normalized snapshots 1500ms apart. Control states observed: closed = class 'hiding' + title 'Show Transcript'; open = class 'showing' + title 'Hide Transcript'.

loadingRegionNote: no loading/error element exists inside .transcript-viewer on the observed shape. The initial 'loading' label is outside the transcript container, and the page-level layout-loading class persists after completion (present on fully rendered captures), so neither is a completion or loading signal. Snapshot stability carries completeness for this shape.
timestampFormat: separate .transcript-time div (MM:SS or H:MM:SS, no brackets or delimiters in the source) plus .transcript-text div per row; the timestamped form is serialized one line per row as "[H:MM:SS] text", which the normative timestamp regex fully consumes
spaNote: recordings open by full document navigation from the overview (anchor link, full document capture per recording); the plan's popstate + 1000ms URL poll remains installed as defense for in-player URL changes
